// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the code.
User* (xref:#entidad-user[User])::
User the code was sent to.
Purpose* (UserVerificationCodePurposeOptions)::
Action the code verifies.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * PASSWORD_RECOVERY
 * EMAIL_VERIFICATION
 * ACCOUNT_DELETION

Code hash (string)::
Digest of the code sent by email; the raw value is never stored.
Return url (blob)::
URL the user returns to once the code is verified.
Expires at (datetime)::
When the code stops being valid.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de user verification code para controlar bloqueos optimistas
